contract.task_clause:
A nonconducting sphere is given a nonzero net electric charge, +Q, and then brought close to a neutral conducting sphere of the same radius. Which of the following will be true?
Option A: An electric field will be induced within the conducting sphere.
Option B: The conducting sphere will develop a net electric charge of –Q.
Option C: The spheres will experience an electrostatic attraction.
Option D: The spheres will experience an electrostatic repulsion.
